figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, a gigantic or bulky person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতো মোটা যে গজকচ্ছপ বলে ডাকা যায়।
পার্টিতে গজকচ্ছপের মতো লোকটি সবাইকে চাপা দিয়ে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He's so fat that we can call him a Gajkacchho. (sarcastically)
The guy at the party was like a Gajkacchho, overshadowing everyone.
note: Refers to a mythical hybrid creature in folklore, used for humorous derision
